newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee unit taps FCB Chicago as agency.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee unit taps FCB Chicago as agency.

text.p: Sara Lee Bakery, a division of Sara Lee Corp, Tuesday named FCB Chicago the agency of record for its Grocery Division and hired FCB IMPACT to handle its promotion activities.
A Sara Lee spokesman said the advertising component had billings of about $10 million.
FCB Chicago will be responsible for the advertising efforts for a variety of Sara Lee Bakery fresh and frozen products, including the Sara Lee, Chef Pierre, Mr. Pita and Wolferman's lines.

Appointing the advertising subsidiary of Chicago-based True North Communications Inc to the account ends a month-long review that included eight agencies, according to Scott Pattullo, vice president of marketing for Sara Lee Bakery.
"We wanted to go into a new direction," Pattullo explained, "and we focused on Chicago agencies because we wanted to work with someone close by who was familiar with our business."
The account was previously handled by Ammirati Puris Lintas Worldwide in New York, which managed the account for more than five years.
